title: Wiemer contact form
description: A pale grey contact section: a centred orange mono tag, a large heading and one line of reassurance, then a narrow near-white card on a perforated-plate field of pale dots with name, email and message fields, a consent checkbox and a full-width blue send bar. Dots darken where the pointer passes.
notes: a plain HTML form (action prop); no JavaScript
the dot field shows from lg up
